paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets. Targeted refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition (i.e., in the conceptualization phase) and/or publications in which the authors define concrete measures to ensure and validate the presence of at least one target group in the data (i.e., in the operationalization phase). Untargeted refers to all other datasets that do not meet these two criteria. Note that the data for 2022 is only partially available (as described in our Methods and Data Section).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as either "Targeted" or "Untargeted" from 2012 to 2022, with each year represented on the horizontal axis and the number of datasets on the vertical axis, which ranges from 0 to 160 in increments of 20. The bars are stacked, with blue representing "Untargeted" datasets and orange representing "Targeted" datasets, as indicated in the legend. For each year, the total height of the stacked bar corresponds to the total number of datasets, with the blue portion at the bottom and the orange portion on top. In 2012, there is a small blue bar (approximately 2 datasets) and a negligible orange bar. From 2013 to 2015, the blue bars remain small (around 2–4), while the orange bars are minimal or absent. In 2016, the blue bar increases slightly (around 4), and the orange bar rises to about 10. In 2017, the blue bar reaches approximately 15, and the orange bar is around 15. In 2018, both bars are roughly equal at about 20 each. In 2019, the blue bar is about 15, and the orange bar is around 50. In 2020, the blue bar is approximately 45, and the orange bar is about 80. In 2021, the blue bar is around 65, and the orange bar is approximately 95, making the total height about 160. For 2022, the blue bar is about 15, and the orange bar is approximately 25, totaling around 40, with a note in the caption indicating that 2022 data is only partially available. The bars are arranged chronologically from left to right, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular year or category.
